parameter_source: FastRP, Chen et al., CIKM 2019, arXiv:1908.11512: N_i = A N_{i-1}, A = D^-1 S, N_1 = A L R, L_jj = (d_j/2m)^beta, R very sparse with s = sqrt(n), alpha_1 = alpha_2 = 0, alpha_3 = 1, alpha_4 searched in [2^-3, 2^6], beta searched in [-1, 0]. alpha_4 = 1 and beta = -0.5 are untuned values inside the search ranges. The paper uses d = 512; d = 8192 is used here because top-k neighbours on this small graph change too much between seeds at 512.
stability_source: On the A8 graph (56 topics) the median exact rank-5 cosine is about 0.006 while the between-seed standard deviation of one run at d = 8192 is about 0.010, so ranks 3-5 were noise and top-5 sets of two seeds overlapped about 50%. Changing beta or the iteration weights did not help. Cosine is therefore averaged over seed_count consecutive seeds (standard deviation about 0.004) and neighbours below min_cosine (about 5 standard deviations) are not listed, so a topic can have fewer than top_k neighbours or none.
